content: {"episode_id":"ep-05055","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), denied under PR-204 as not covered under the member’s current benefit plan. The patient has recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or tachy-brady syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy."}
